rationale: It is the smallest complete design that threads one gh-store account binding through install, the mirror, start/resume/attach, launchers, wipe and PR calls via reset-then-account credential helpers and a gh/git-only runner wrapper, while cursor's plan leaks the token into product checks and loses to inherited helpers and codex's adds a stale-prone second keychain store, a native dependency, and upgrade-breaking mandatory selection; the remaining review points (sameRemote userinfo, launcher-time validation, docs/test-config commands) are revision-sized fixes.
